label: ASR

shape.name: receptive-point-bowl
shape.description: Open upward-facing parabolic bowl with an unmistakable doubled lip, curved bottom, nine meridians, and six inward receiving paths.
shape.topology: open bowl cage with convergent routes
shape.silhouette: A concave receiver with visible floor and lip, never a sequence of free-standing wave rings.
shape.label: 音を集める椀

motion.phaseMeaning: On incoming routes: 0 at their high outer ends →1 at bowl floor. On bowl traces: 0.36 at rim →1 toward floor. Rim phase is fixed at 0.36.
rules: Animate brightness on anchored coordinates; never integrate particle positions over time.
Keep all structural points visible when idle, offline, or at zero activity.
Health selects one uniform color for the whole object; group is never a color category.
Use bounded, modulo-wrapped time. Activity changes speed and pulse amplitude, not the silhouette.
Reduced motion uses the rest coordinates and constant per-point weight.
motion.flowAxis: inward and downward, +Z mouth to −Z floor
motion.suggestion: A brightness packet descends the six receive paths and converges along the bowl toward its floor. Let the floor softly accumulate light, without extinguishing the rim.

provenance: Approved monitoring-galaxy point-cloud form study; final deterministic provider geometry.

rendering.seedUsage: Stable visual variation only; never make silhouette depend on seed or elapsed time.
